name: EffiGov
long_description:
EffiGov builds AI agents for local government, helping cities, counties, and public agencies automate resident communications across phone, web chat, email, and SMS.

Our AI agents serve more than 2 million residents across 10+ government agencies, answering questions 24/7, handling service requests, looking up permit information, scheduling inspections, and routing complex inquiries to staff. In Sumter County, Florida, EffiGov handles over 12,000 calls per month, with approximately 72% handled without staff intervention.

Unlike traditional IVR systems and generic AI receptionists, EffiGov builds specialized AI agents for government departments, including public works, utilities, permitting, code enforcement, and 311. Our platform integrates with existing phone systems and government software, including Esri ArcGIS, SeeClickFix, and Accela.

Backed by Y Combinator (S25), EffiGov is building the AI infrastructure for local government, starting with the phone.
one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Local Government
